summary: Texas teen went missing during a solo day hike to the top of Greenhorn Mountain near Rye; 3-day multi-agency search (19 agencies, 100+ personnel, ATVs, helicopters, K9, mounted teams); teen walked out to a house in Gardner on July 22, hungry but uninjured
responding_agency: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue (coordinated; with CSU-Pueblo student SAR, Colorado SAR Association, Huerfano County SO)
notes: Date pinned to 2020-07-20 via weekday verification (Monday July 20, 2020) from the 2021-02-26 Share Pueblo article: missing Mon July 20 – Wed July 22. No name published in the source.
